userCompletion: 사용자는 허용한 앱의 foreground identity, coarse duration, AFK만 로컬에서 보고 pause, private, include/exclude, export, delete를 통제한다.

referencePrinciples.adopt: frontmost app that receives key events

referencePrinciples.reject: window text, browser history, or other user sessions

referencePrinciples.adopt: merge adjacent identical coarse events and expose deletion/export
referencePrinciples.reject: raw title, URL, category, productivity, persona, or provider Context defaults

failureFamilies.name: default-on-surveillance

failureFamilies.name: title-url-content-capture

failureFamilies.name: foreground-identity-forgery

failureFamilies.name: heartbeat-storage-storm

failureFamilies.name: afk-time-lie

failureFamilies.name: work-causality-overclaim

failureFamilies.name: persona-productivity-inference

failureFamilies.name: include-exclude-race

failureFamilies.name: pause-private-delete-false

failureFamilies.name: other-user-remote-private-browser
